name: Crabgron
look: a charcoal crab with glowing blue eyes and a spiky shell; its right claw is an Aggron's head, borrowed from Cobblemon's own Aggron, its left a big white pincer
entry: As it grows, its claw takes on the look of an iron-armoured beast, horns and all. Crabgron bang their helmet-claws on rocks at night so that anything listening believes a whole herd is near.
how: Evolve Tyrucrab at level 32. It learns Metal Claw when it evolves.
Wild: rare on beaches, stony shores, mangrove swamps and in badlands.
